summary: Western Copper & Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting the voting results from its annual general meeting of shareholders held on June 12, 2026. The filing details the election of directors and appointment of auditor, with 52.21% of shares represented. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is disclosed. This is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer providing standard AGM results, not a special situation.
